title: ranunculus bongardii var. douglasii
intro: Ranunculus bongardii var. douglasii, commonly known as Yellow Sea Buttercup, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and fever. The health benefits of Yellow Sea Buttercup include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to soothe irritated tissues and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and spasmolytic effects.
